messages:
Priya (AE): Quick align for PayMesh POC. Customer wants invoice parsing + payment reconciliation + chargeback/fraud flagging. Need endpoints, evals, timeline, pricing (hosted vs Dedicated), security Qs. Can SE + Sec join?

Tom (SE): Yep. From SOW: endpoints: /parse-invoice (line items, vendor id), /match-payments (fuzzy match), /flag-chargeback (label + reason). Target peak ~5 QPS, p99 <300ms for interactive.

Ana (Solutions): Proposed success criteria: classifier F1 >=95%; reconciliation match >=90% on holdout; cost target < $0.003/token. They will provide 500 labeled invoices + ~200 chargeback examples.

Tom (SE): Technical plan: embeddings for candidate retrieval + reranker for reconcile; streaming logits + top-3 reasons for chargeback. Need gold eval set of 500 examples per endpoint. Recommend 4-week POC schedule: week0 kickoff, week1 infra+stubs, week2 baseline evals & prompt tuning, week3 integration & acceptance, week4 buffer/legal. Customer asked 3 weeks but we should push 4.

Priya (AE): Pricing sketch: hosted PAYG ~ $2.4k/mo at expected load; small Dedicated pool ~ $8.5k/mo (ballpark). I'll push for committed discount conversation.

Maria (Security): They require EU data residency, SOC2, and KMS. We can host EU, support customer KMS for Dedicated/Private; HSM for Private needs legal signoff. I'll answer questionnaire (link shared in meeting). ETA ~10 business days.

Ana (Solutions): Action items: 1) SEs publish quickstart + sample prompts. 2) Tom to produce tokenized cost estimate using 100k reqs/month baseline. 3) Maria to complete security Qs. 4) Priya to attach SOW + payload samples. Propose sync Mon 10am PT to lock scope.

Priya (AE): Monday 10am PT works. I'll send invite and attach docs. :thumbsup:
